description: This file defines the `GatewayRemoteConfig` enum which contains static methods for resolving and normalizing remote gateway configurations, including URLs, tokens, and transport types, for a macOS application.

methods.name: resolveTransport
methods.description: Resolves the transport type (direct or ssh) from a nested dictionary representing the configuration.

methods.name: resolveUrlString
methods.description: Extracts and trims the gateway URL string from the configuration dictionary.

methods.name: resolveTokenValue
methods.description: Determines the token value, handling missing, non-string, or empty tokens.

methods.name: resolveTokenString
methods.description: Returns the token string if available.

methods.name: resolveGatewayUrl
methods.description: Resolves the gateway URL as a URL object, normalizing it.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrlString
methods.description: Converts a raw URL string into a normalized absolute string.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a raw URL string into a URL object, ensuring it uses ws/wss scheme and has proper host and port.

methods.name: defaultPort
methods.description: Provides default port numbers based on URL scheme if none is specified.
